newsitem.title: USA: Carriage Services sees better Q4, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Carriage Services sees better Q4, 1997.

text.p: Carriage Services Inc said it expects operating performance to substantially improve over the balance of the year and into 1997 as the death rate seasonally increases and recently acquired properties are transitioned into its operating framework.
Earlier, the company reported a third quarter and year-to-date loss.

Melvin Payne, president and chief executive commented, "Although our revenues increased significantly during the third quarter, a prolonged seasonal decline in the death rate in many of our markets and lower than expected performance from newly acquired properties reduced expected operating income and margins.

"Since becoming a public company, our acquisition opportunities have substantially increased with many funeral home and cemetery owners viewing Carriage as a young, quality company with a great future in this industry."
"This perception on the part of premier funeral home and cemetery owners should enable Carriage to continue its rapid acquisition pace over the foreseeable future," Payne said.
